context.comparisonRule: The stated goal and its hard constraints outrank recent return.

goal.name: Income
goal.words: Produce dependable income without taking a large capital-loss risk.

goal.name: Capital preservation
goal.words: Protect capital first; return comes second.

goal.name: Growth
goal.words: Seek long-term capital growth without adding an unrequested currency bet.

goal.name: Inflation hedge
goal.words: Hold a meaningful real-asset sleeve while remaining diversified and liquid.

goal.name: Low drawdown
goal.words: Avoid deep falls, even if that means giving up the highest recent return.
